name: BaBar
summary: BaBar was located at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, Menlo Park, California. Its single-photon results from the historical B-factory experiment provide important light-dark-sector constraints.
physics_targets: Dark photons and dark Higgs bosons
detection_principle: A single energetic photon with missing energy/momentum is sought in e⁺e⁻ collisions; the invisible-system mass is reconstructed from initial-state and photon four-momenta.

results.summary: No invisible-dark-photon signal; model-dependent 90% confidence upper bounds on coupling were obtained for mediators up to 8 GeV.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
